name: Manila
summary: Manila is the capital of the Philippines and one of the great business hubs in Southeast Asia, with a remarkably low cost of living for digital nomads who earn in hard currencies. The city combines modern skyscrapers in districts such as Makati or BGC with the Spanish colonial heritage of Intramuros and a lively food and cultural scene. It is important to be honest: traffic in Manila is among the most congested in the world and public safety is below average, so choosing the neighborhood well and taking basic precautions is key to enjoying the city peacefully.
